# Frozen RC.1 distribution fixture

These unmodified historical fixtures are copied from release source
`9d9ed9744c29a494d45501a8bb1359edd465c5c4` (`v0.1.0-rc.1`). They preserve the earlier
snapshot and its licence notices. The [foundation check](../../../scripts/check_foundation.py) pins the module and licence
from the promoted v1.0.1 build. Branch-policy tests use synthetic payloads. This directory
is test data, not an installation or current candidate package.

The module is stored as `thermostat-rc1.fixture.js` so Marketplace can identify
the installable module by filename. Its contents match the original RC.1 file.
